Sub:   Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015”) – Outcome of Earnings Call - Audio 
Recording. 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am,  
 
This is further to our letter dated October 19, 2026, wherein we had given an advance intimation of the 
Conference Call to discuss 2QFY27 Earnings of the Company in terms of Regulation 30(6) read with    
Para A(15) of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015. 
 
We wish to inform you that the Company today conducted Conference Call to discuss 2QFY27 Earnings 
of the Company with Several Funds/Investors/Analysts through Audio mode in Mumbai with respect 
to the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the Quarter and 
Half Year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
The Audio Recording of the aforesaid Conference Call is available on the Company’s website at the 
weblink: https://www.abdindia.com/investors-center/financial-information/results. 
 
Please note the aforesaid Conference Call commenced at 4:30 P.M. and concluded at 5:46 P.M. (IST). 
 
Please note that the Company has referred to publicly available documents for discussions and no 
Unpublished Price Sensitive Information has been shared during the aforesaid Conference Call. 
 
This intimation is also being uploaded on Company’s website and can be accessed at 
https://www.abdindia.com/.  
 
The above is for your information and record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours sincerely,  
For Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited 
 
 
Sumeet Maheshwari 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
